properties.value: Dual-laminate FRP/HDPE/rubber-lined CS on raw-acid stages; 316L or coated CS only after pH is reliably ≥6.5
properties.note: scope: T-1006 and R-1001/R-1002/R-1003/R-1004 treatment tanks; alt: Vinyl-ester FRP throughout where abrasion and temperature are within rating; status FIRM | D-A1000-MOC: Plant-wide ruling: FEED-PE-MAT-002 'Recommended MOC (base case)' governs material of construction over FEED-PE-MDL-001 (scale-up study) and design-note wording — MAT-002 is the controlled MoC matrix and postdates MDL-001. Wording variants of the same material family are superseded by the MAT-002 statement.
